## Privacy and Safety Checklist

- [ ] I used fake contacts and synthetic chat data for tests or examples.
- [ ] I did not commit real contact aliases, partner context, personal chat screenshots, secrets, or tokens.
- [ ] Any Tauri/e2e validation used disposable app state, temporary `HOME`, or a temporary app data directory.
